title: Combat history
selectDay: Select a day on the heatmap to list its encounters.
emptyDay: No encounters were recorded on this day.
emptyHistory: No combat history yet. Start a capture and fight: every finished encounter appears here.
localOnly: Combat history is stored only on this PC, and this file is not encrypted.
loadFailed: The combat history could not be read.
recovered: {{n}} encounters that an earlier run left unfinished are marked as unfinished.
correlatedNote: Named through a Master relation that is not directly confirmed (for example an indirect link, or a record of another game version)
unreliableDps: Part of this encounter's data or a boundary may be missing, so no DPS is shown.
versionUnknown: No game version was recorded for this encounter
incompleteNote: Part of this record could not be saved, so the stored values may be lower than what happened.
openNote: This encounter is still in progress. Its statistics are saved when it ends.
abandonedNote: WWlogs closed before this encounter finished, so its statistics were not saved.
noEnemies: No enemy was confirmed in this encounter.

unavailable.newer_schema: This history was written by a newer WWlogs. It is kept unchanged and is not shown or recorded by this version.
unavailable.locked_by_other_process: Another WWlogs window is recording this history. This window only reads it and records nothing.
unavailable.not_a_history_file: The history file is not a WWlogs history and was left unchanged. No history is recorded.
unavailable.integrity_check_failed: The history file failed its integrity check and was left unchanged. No history is recorded.
unavailable.open_failed: The history could not be opened. Capture works as usual, but no history is recorded.
unavailable.storage_stopped: Saving history stopped after repeated write errors. Capture works as usual.
unavailable.key_missing: The history file exists but its key file is missing. The file was left unchanged and no history is recorded. Restore combat-history.key to read it.
unavailable.key_unavailable: Windows could not unlock the history key for this user. The file was left unchanged and no history is recorded.
unavailable.key_mismatch: The history key does not open the history file. The file was left unchanged and no history is recorded.
unavailable.duplicate_source: This capture file is already in the history, so it is not stored again.

localEncrypted: Combat history is stored only on this PC, encrypted with a key that Windows protects for your user account.
zoneNote: Dates and times follow this PC's current time zone: {{zone}} ({{offset}}).
zoneFallback: The full rules of the current time zone could not be loaded, so the zone WWlogs read from Windows at start is used.

indicator.lost: {{n}} history entries of this capture could not be saved; the encounters they belong to are marked incomplete.

incompleteReason.entries_lost: Part of this record could not be saved, so the stored values may be lower than what happened.
incompleteReason.application_exit: WWlogs closed before this encounter finished.
incompleteReason.recording_disabled: History recording was turned off during this encounter, so it was not recorded to its end.
incompleteReason.not_finished: The capture ended before this encounter finished.

checkpointNote: The values below are the last checkpoint, at {{time}}. The encounter is incomplete; they are not its final result.
olderAccountingNote: An earlier WWlogs analysed this encounter without the damage the server executes itself (negative status damage, for example); its stored values may be lower than a current analysis. Stored records are never recalculated.

coverage.title: What this record contains
coverage.combatStored: Every confirmed damage and healing result
coverage.effectsStored: {{changes}} changes of {{instances}} effects during this encounter
coverage.skillCastsNotStored: Not stored: no reliable source for skill casts exists; the skill table counts damage hits
coverage.effectsDerived: Of these, {{derived}} ends follow from another fact (such as the holder leaving) and {{untracked}} are the end of tracking, not an observed removal.
coverage.effectsRejected: {{n}} effects of this capture could not be tracked and are missing.

delete.recording: An encounter that is still being recorded cannot be deleted.
delete.confirm: Delete this encounter and everything stored for it? This cannot be undone. The data is removed from the history file; this is not a secure erase of the disk.
delete.done: The encounter was deleted from the history.
delete.failed: The deletion failed. Nothing was changed.

refused.encounter_recording: This encounter is still being recorded and cannot be deleted yet.
refused.recording_active: A capture is recording into the history. Stop the capture before clearing it.
refused.not_writable: This window cannot change this history.
refused.not_found: The encounter is no longer in the history.

analysis.enemyUnmapped: This enemy could not be tied to its stored results, so it cannot be filtered by.
analysis.inconsistent: The results stored for this record do not fully rebuild the encounter's result; range values describe only what was stored.
analysis.healingNoEnemy: Healing belongs to no enemy, so it is not shown while an enemy is selected.
analysis.dragHint: Drag on the timeline to select a range; click a line to select a character
analysis.timelineHint: Drag to select a range · Ctrl+wheel to zoom · Shift+wheel to pan · Click a line to select a character
analysis.gap: Capture gap: packets may have been lost here
analysis.gapNote: This encounter has {{n}} capture gaps; effects and events during them may be incomplete.

state.not_finished: Only a finished encounter can be analysed by time: an unfinished record has no final result to check against.
state.too_large: This encounter stored more events than one analysis reads, so it is not analysed.

evidence.stated: By the time the server stated (end not observed)

marker.superseded: Replaced by a new apply (ended no later than this)
marker.continues: Continues past the end of the encounter

effects.none: No effect matches in this range.
effects.selectHint: Select an effect to see its active intervals and their evidence.
effects.hidden: {{n}} more effects are not shown on the game HUD; switch to All tracked to see them.
effects.stale: {{n}} effects had passed the time the server stated before the encounter began and were never heard of again, so they are not listed.
effects.more: {{n}} more rows exceed the display bound and are not listed.
effects.truncated: This encounter holds more effect events than one analysis reads, so effects are not shown.
effects.exactNote: Every part of this range is confirmed by observed messages and there is no capture gap, so the coverage is exact.
effects.boundsNote: Part of this range is not confirmed (stated time only, undetermined, an unconfirmed start or a capture gap), so only a lower bound and a possible upper bound are shown.
effects.refreshNote: An active effect applied again or seen again in a snapshot; it is not a new, separate effect.
effects.inactiveNote: Time in the range with no interval of the effect and outside capture gaps. With a gap, a rejected effect change or a stale instance, it is only an upper bound.
effects.unobservedNote: Time before the effect was first seen (for example in a snapshot), when it may already have been active.

skills.hitsAreNotCasts: Hits are damage hits, not skill casts
skills.selectHint: Select a skill to mark each of its hits on the timeline.
skills.detailHint: Select a skill to see its hit statistics in this range.
skills.distributionNote: The distribution shows this skill's damage over the whole encounter (enemy filter applied); the highlighted part is the selected range.
skills.statusDistributionNote: The distribution shows this negative status's damage over the whole encounter (enemy filter applied); the highlighted part is the selected range.
skills.statusSettlementsNote: The server settles negative status damage; the hit count is the number of settlements, not of applications.

events.downgraded: Attribution was paused after a transport loss, so this result was not credited to the team

icon.aria: Icon timeline: skill hits and effect intervals
icon.empty: Nothing to show on the timeline.
icon.hitsFailed: The skill hits could not be read.
icon.hitsTruncated: {{total}} skill hits; the timeline draws the first {{listed}}.
icon.untimed: {{n}} more hits have no time and cannot be placed on the timeline.

hits.title: Selected hits
hits.note: Hits close in time are only drawn together: a hit is a damage result, not a skill cast, and a group of hits is not one cast.
hits.mark: Mark this skill's hits on the DPS lines
hits.markStatus: Mark this negative status's hits on the DPS lines
hits.more: {{n}} more are not listed; the Events tab lists them all.

segment.title: Selected interval
segment.nextFact: The effect is heard of again afterwards

correlation.title: Damage during the effect
correlation.note: Places the confirmed hits against this effect's intervals by time. It shows what happened at the same time, never how much damage the effect added, and computes no rDPS.

classNote.confirmed: The hit landed inside an interval the recorded changes confirm.
classNote.stated: The hit landed only within the server's stated duration; the end was not observed.
classNote.unknown: The effect's state then cannot be told; the reasons are listed below.
classNote.outside: The recorded changes show the effect was not active then.

reason.start_unconfirmed: before the effect was first seen
reason.simultaneous: the same instant as a change of the effect
reason.rejected_changes: rejected effect changes that cannot be ruled out
reason.stale_instance: a stale instance that cannot be ruled out

correlation.untimed: {{n}} hits have no time and cannot be placed.
correlation.noHits: No confirmed hits in the selection.
correlation.unavailable: This encounter holds more effect changes than one analysis reads, or not this effect: nothing can be placed.
correlation.failed: The correlation could not be read.
correlation.listMore: The first {{n}} of {{total}}; the Events tab lists them all.

library.rolesNote: Characters lists the characters that dealt confirmed damage, not a full team; a trial character shows as its own character.

classNote.complete: Complete: every result was stored, data integrity is INTACT and no defect is known. Counts for personal records.
classNote.degraded: Transport loss: totals and DPS are lower bounds. Not used for personal records.
classNote.known_affected: The build that analysed this record missed results whose RequestId was reused after the counter wrapped (fixed in v0.7.0 Build 32), so its values may be low. Not used for personal records; stored values are never rewritten.
classNote.incomplete: Some results were not stored: the values are not the whole result. Not counted in totals or personal records.
classNote.unreliable: A boundary or the extent of a loss is unknown: no DPS is shown. Not counted in totals or personal records.
classNote.unfinished: Still recording, or ended with the application: the values are a checkpoint. Not counted in totals or personal records.

compare.full: The comparison is full (up to {{n}} encounters)
compare.needTwo: Choose at least two encounters to compare.
compare.title: Comparing {{n}} encounters
compare.durationRatio: The longest encounter is {{ratio}} times the shortest; DPS depends on encounter length.
compare.openWorldNote: Includes open-world encounters: enemies and conditions are not fixed, so the values are for reference only.
compare.hpNote: Enemy HP, level and states are not recorded; the same stage can still differ.
compare.noScore: The comparison lists stored facts and changes only; it computes no fairness score.
compare.unreliable: Not every encounter is a complete record: changes are given between complete records only, and other values are marked by their record class.
compare.deltaNote: Changes are measured from the first encounter.

status.lower_bound: Lower bound: the true value may be higher
status.partial: Part of a result from an incomplete record

compare.noResults: An encounter without stored results shows its time and state only.
compare.contributorsNote: Lined up by character, a trial character counting as its own; a dash means no confirmed damage in that encounter. Shares are of that encounter's confirmed damage.
compare.notDealt: No confirmed damage in this encounter
compare.dpsDeltaNote: Change of the character's DPS from the first encounter (complete records only)
compare.skillsNote: Shares are of the character's confirmed damage in that encounter.

career.title: Career overview
career.subtitle: Totals across the fights WWlogs recorded on this PC
career.damageLowerBound: Includes records with transport loss or a known undercount: the total is a lower bound
career.olderAccounting: {{count}} encounters were analysed by an earlier WWlogs that did not count server-executed damage; their totals and records may be low.
career.heatmapTrimmed: The range is longer than 53 weeks: the heatmap shows the last 53, the totals cover the whole range.
career.dayHint: Choose a day to see its encounters in History.
career.charactersNote: Characters that dealt confirmed damage; a trial character counts as its own character.
career.charactersEmpty: No character dealt confirmed damage in this range.
career.characterOpen: List the encounters of {{name}} in History
career.combosNote: Characters that dealt confirmed damage in the same encounter, not a team: teammates who dealt no damage and the team itself are not recorded.
career.combosEmpty: No counted combination in this range.

trendNote.encounters: Stored encounters per day, every record class included.
trendNote.damage: Confirmed damage of the counted encounters per day; a day with a lower bound shows ≥.
trendNote.time: Duration of the counted encounters per day.
trendNote.bestDps: The best Encounter DPS of the complete records per day; a day without one shows nothing.

career.trendEmpty: Nothing to show in this range.
career.placesNote: Lists encounters whose stage or scene was identified; ≈ marks a name inferred from the Master. Choose a row to list its encounters in History.
career.empty: Nothing to total yet. Start a capture and finish a fight: your career on this PC builds up here.
career.emptyFiltered: No encounter in this range or filter.

rule.totals: Totals include complete, transport-loss and known-undercount records; the last two are lower bounds, shown with ≥.
rule.records: Personal records come from complete records only, and each opens the encounter it came from.
rule.dps: Encounter DPS is the confirmed damage of an encounter over its elapsed wall-clock time; a character's DPS is its confirmed damage over the same time.
rule.excluded: Incomplete, unreliable and unfinished records count as encounters only.
rule.stored: Values come from the stored records; an older record is never recalculated or rewritten.

trendRoleNote.encounters: Encounters per day in which this character dealt confirmed damage.
trendRoleNote.damage: This character's confirmed damage in the counted encounters per day; a day with a lower bound shows ≥.
trendRoleNote.bestDps: This character's best DPS in the complete records per day (its confirmed damage over the encounter's elapsed time); a day without one shows nothing.

career.dpsCaution: DPS depends on the mode, stage, enemies and encounter length: values from different conditions are not directly comparable. Use the mode and stage filters above to keep to the same conditions.
